answer_1.quote: Modern MLLMs like GPT-4o and LLaVA-NeXT have exhibited remarkable proficiency across various vision-language tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering (VQA), and visual reasoning.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers for Yes-No, Multiple-Choice, and Open-Ended questions in response to visual inputs.

answer_2.quote: We use Accuracy and Memorization Ratio (MR) as the main evaluation metrics in our experiment.

answer_4.quote: For Open-Ended questions, due to the complexity of the task and the instability of LLM evaluation, we rely on human annotators to perform the classification.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators determine correctness based on two criteria: Relevancy and Responsiveness.
